provenance: Canonical S-phase and G2/M cell-cycle gene signature of Tirosh et al. 2016 (Science 352:189-196), as distributed in Seurat (cc.genes / cc.genes.updated.2019). Used UNCHANGED here as a generic, published, pig-independent proliferation index. This is a standard gene-symbol signature, not a list derived from this study's own VIP rankings, so it is a fair adversarial baseline.
